description: This file defines a class 'QemuTinyRunner' that extends 'QemuRunner' to facilitate starting and controlling QEMU virtual machine instances specifically for 'poky tiny'. It provides methods to start QEMU, create sockets for serial communication, run commands serially over the socket, and find child processes related to QEMU. The code is used within a testing and automation context for embedded Linux environments.

classes.name: QemuTinyRunner
classes.description: A class for managing a QEMU instance configured for tiny poky images, with methods for starting, serial communication, socket management, and process identification.

methods.name: __init__(self, machine, rootfs, display, tmpdir, deploy_dir_image, logfile, kernel, boottime, logger, tmpfsdir=None)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes QemuTinyRunner with configuration parameters including machine type, root filesystem, display, directories, kernel, and logger.

methods.name: create_socket(self)
methods.description: Creates a UNIX domain socket to communicate with the serial console of the QEMU instance.

methods.name: log(self, msg)
methods.description: Appends a message to the logfile if configured.

methods.name: start(self, qemuparams = None, ssh=True, extra_bootparams=None, runqemuparams='', discard_writes=True)
methods.description: Starts the QEMU process with specified parameters, manages environment variables, and waits for its PID to confirm startup.

methods.name: run_serial(self, command, timeout=60)
methods.description: Sends a command over the serial socket to the QEMU instance and collects the response, with a timeout.

methods.name: find_child(self,parent_pid)
methods.description: Finds the child process of the parent PID that corresponds to the QEMU process, inspecting process tree via 'ps'.
